subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial checklist and two timeline scenarios
body:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@clearwave.ai>, Tom Price <t.price@healthrow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial checklist and two timeline scenarios

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — really useful conversation. Per our call I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) with a lightweight checklist of milestones, proposed owners, and two timeline scenarios (Conservative vs Accelerated). The file also includes the discovery notes I captured in the call.

Quick recap of key commitments we discussed:
- Goal: deploy a pilot integration of Redwood inference for triage routing and summary generation across one clinical workflow.
- Success metric: reduce manual triage time by 30% for the pilot cohort.
- Initial scope: integration to the triage UI + event-level logging; model choices to be finalized by model onboarding step.

What I attached:
- clearwave_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft: milestones, owners, dependencies)
- discovery-notes.txt (call notes / open questions)

Two timeline options in the MAP:
1) Accelerated (8 weeks):
   - Week 1: finalize stakeholder roster + access accounts (Samantha lead)
   - Week 2–3: environment access + integration stub
   - Week 4–5: pilot model tuning and QA
   - Week 6–8: pilot validation + metrics baseline
   - Dependencies: infra access, SOC checklist signoff
2) Conservative (14 weeks): same milestones with additional buffer for procurement and compliance reviews (adds gating and formal signoffs).

Asks:
1) Please confirm the internal stakeholders who should be on the MAP (names + roles). I included the folks we mentioned on the call but want to ensure nothing missing.
2) Which timeline looks realistic from your side — Accelerated or Conservative? If Accelerated, confirm whether procurement/compliance can commit to a 2-week turnaround for access.
3) Any additional dependencies we missed (third-party vendors, contract approvals)?

If helpful I can convert the MAP to a one-page shared plan in HubSpot and lock owners to tasks.

Next steps: If I don’t hear back by end of next week I’ll follow up with a proposed kickoff date for the Conservative timeline.

Thanks,

--
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@clearwave.ai>

Cc: Tom Price <t.price@healthrow.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — initial checklist and two timeline scenarios

Thanks Nikhil — appreciate the clear summary. I reviewed the draft and it looks good overall. A few quick notes:

- Stakeholders: please add Rachel Ortiz (Clinical Ops) and Mark Han (Security). I’ll introduce them in a separate thread this week.
- Timeline: Accelerated would be great but we need confirmation from Security on the SOC checklist; they typically need 10 business days. That makes the Accelerated plan tight unless we get a fast-track signoff.
- Dependencies: we use an internal SSO provider (AuthCorp) for test environments — adding that vendor as a dependency.

I’m happy to own the stakeholder introductions. If you can add Rachel and Mark to the MAP and re-share, we’ll confirm the procurement/compliance timelines.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product
ClearWave Health

Nikhil — quick internal note after reading Samantha’s reply.

1) Add Rachel Ortiz and Mark Han to internal stakeholders (as Samantha requested).
2) Suggest we present a hybrid timeline: begin with the Accelerated milestone plan but insert a 1-week conditional hold before Week 2 that gates on Security SOC acknowledgement. This keeps pressure but avoids overpromising.
3) Recommend we flag AuthCorp as a third-party dependency and add an item for SSO integration verification (Ben to own).

I updated the MAP with those changes and attached a small delta sheet (I’ll push final version once we get Rachel/Mark added).

– Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Samantha / Tom — thanks for the quick read and the stakeholder additions.

Action items from my side:
- I’ll add Rachel Ortiz and Mark Han to the MAP and upload the updated version to the HubSpot deal record (link below).
- I’ll adopt Marissa’s hybrid timeline suggestion and flag a 1-week conditional hold before Week 2 for Security SOC acknowledgement.
- Ben will coordinate the AuthCorp SSO verification task and add acceptance criteria.

Can you confirm two things so we can lock dates:
1) Who is the primary contact for procurement (legal/finance) at ClearWave? (name + email)
2) Do you want the kickoff as a calendar invite (30 min) to align stakeholders, or a short working session (60–90 min) that also includes tech deep-dive?

I’ll re-share the updated MAP in the next 24 hours.

Link to draft in HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/rdw-459

Thanks — looking forward to getting a kickoff on the calendar.
